dedupe_keys.name: inner mongolia natural gas and well liquid level observations

description: Science Data Bank publishes natural-gas production and well liquid-level observations from wells in Inner Mongolia, China, mainly targeting the Shanxi Formation. The own page states coverage from 17 March 2010 to 15 April 2024 and names wellhead pressure, casing pressure, daily methanol injection and cumulative gas, water and oil production. One public package is listed, free under CC BY 4.0. The describing article says individual wells have spreadsheet files, but the internal package was not opened. These histories can calibrate production-decline or fluid-accumulation models used in gas-supply simulations. No directly related catalogue record was identified. A caveat is that operating practice and geology are local; daily records alone do not establish reserve size, well reliability or infrastructure capacity under changed controls. Sampling intervals, missing fields and well identities need checking in the files before model use. The own page and registry metadata were verified without downloading observations.
